# QR-learner (vendored)

`6a62bd6b0bbf8e90c43d4108c3be227b3e4c0e6a`, copied without modification.
`LICENSE` is the upstream MIT license, also unmodified.

SHA-256 of `official_learners.py`:
`53fed0507d2d66f206534ea57f3d24a6520f157451d9555fffd219b27939be8d`

The file is used only by `code/run_qr_learner.py` for the QR-learner comparison.
If you use the QR-learner, cite the original authors (Karlsson et al., AISTATS 2026).
